title: Register the 2027 HSA cap and add average_contribution
body: Adds the 2027 HSA family cap (Rev. Proc. 2026-31), registers hsa-cap-2027 in the rule registry, and adds an average_contribution helper with tests.
custom_instructions: On a calculation/logic diff, flag it if there is no unit test, or if the test only mirrors the new code with no citable source. A green test that only mirrors the new code does not count.
